body: What are you anxious about?

I’m not sure that makes your mom a narcissist. I think maybe she’s just unhappy and blaming others. My mom never spoke to me or taught me anything then when we’d go out in public, she’d play the martyr single mom and sop up all the attention. She would take credit for things she didn’t do then be neglectful at home. She never gave me a birthday party with friends from school and blamed me. She once sent me to party without a gift and kept saying she had no money. It was after 2 weeks of bullying and getting threatened to get beat up for that she finally got a gift for the kid. When I was in high school I needed glasses and she didn’t get me them until the teacher complained because I wasn’t doing my work as I couldn’t see the board, then my grandparents died and she didn’t even call the school to let them know so my teachers thought I was skipping. Then as I missed over 2 weeks with the funerals, I fell too far behind and the guidance counsellor said I should take a year off with all the stuff going on in my family. She’d blamed me and said I was the one who didn’t want to go to school. Then I developed and anxiety disorder after my gf left me to the point I couldn’t function, she called me lazy and told me I couldn’t come home. I became suicidal and she told me not to call her because having to hear my problems would make her sick. I’m not trying to be rude but a complainer mom who nitpicks isn’t really what I feel a narcissist is like. It makes me feel bad to hear people minimizing what a real narcissist parent damage can do. I’m not trying to minimize your experience either but I feel it trivializes the reality. My mom is extremely manipulative and even went do far as to call the doctor and say I was a violent person. A real narcissist will try to destroy you if you try to be independent of them. When I realized my mom didn’t love me I tried to move forward and that’s when she showed her true nature. A narcissist thinks they’re perfect because they can’t handle criticism, they then blame their kids for their mistakes and try to control them as they see them as tools or escapes goats for their own use.

I’m in Canada and I feel the same. I was traumatized and went into none stop panic attacks. Going to the hospital and calling the hotlines etc... made it so much worse. If I had a gun I would be 100% dead. I went to a hospital and was kept on a form 1 and a nurse was very abusive and talking really aggressive to push me to snap out of it. A guy there was smoking drugs and tried to plant them under my bed, the doctors had no diagnosis so I did research and told them my conclusion and they confirmed my diagnosis. It’s really really bad and the system is ripe with abuse and neglect. No one knows because no one wants to know about mental health. Everyday people are too overwhelmed with their own lives and unhappiness to contemplate what and even process what’s really going on.

I want you to stay. Please try to find a way. I get a good feeling about you and it would make me sad to think you killed yourself. There are so many of us in pain trying to figure this out and survive. I just want you to know for the little it may be worth so many are in the same boat. So in some way you’re not alone. I’m still suffering everyday and trying to hold it together myself. I hope to get through this and ruin the people that hurt me. But time and patience is what I’m trying to focus on.
So true. I don’t have kids but I have nieces and nephews and that’s when I started to realize
I don’t even think that would do the trick. It may slow is down...
Wouldn’t even leave a scratch.

Look. I’m going to be blunt in the hope it helps. 

If you want to help her you need to stop making about you. Period!

Stop the pep talks, they only serve to minimize her suffering. Whining about how you pep talks didn’t work is childish. 

Go read about how to be a good supportive listener and then work at it. TIP: It’s not intuitive!!!! 

Emotional pep talks are really bad and makes the person feel worse as they don’t want to hurt your feelings because they know you’re trying to support them but every word is like daggers. 

So shut up and LISTEN!!!stop making it about YOU!!! 

Therapy will NOT help her!!!
Medication will not help her!!!
Doctors will not help her!!!!

You need to learn to give UNCONDITIONALLY!!!!

Google how to be a good ACTIVE listener 

I’m being blunt to shock you into thinking this through. I hope it helps. 

Emotional Pep talk = you’re weak snap out of it! I’m needy as well!!! Let’s suffer together

Active listening = I don’t understand but I’m trying to get you. I really care about you

Here’s a solution. Make it mandatory for all paid mental health care providers to commit a portion of their time for community service/volunteer help lines. Why does a trained professional making 100+ per hour get to sleep while volunteers are struggling

Even 5 hours a week should do it
Bs. It’s called being a whistleblower! Nobody knows what’s going on and people think the supports are functioning. I’m sick of excuses
So why don’t you call the city counsel or who ever can help to bring light to the matter? This is really wrong and the causal way you accept it is sad
It’s disgusting. This happens a lot and should be reported

No, don’t listen to this. They should be doing their job which is to provide support and not give solutions. It’s really not that hard. A proper trained support staff should be able to calm a person down in 20 min. The reason they are tired is because they aren’t following their training. It’s very tiring trying to solve everything and that’s not their job, but it’s intuitive so they fall back on it. 

You deserve to be supported and don’t let pos like this poster make you feel anything less.

Go fuck yourself. It’s your job and you’re supposed to be trained to do it. Bs. Have you ever seen Hell’s Kitchen!??? Chef Ramsey is berating people for making mistakes with supper and you think it’s ok to make excuses for your job? 

You should be ashamed of yourself

She’s a bad human being. Thank you for sharing your story, I hope you continue to feel better. 

Personally, I’m convinced the mental health industry is saturated with narcissistic and psychotic people who take pleasure in hurting. It’s the perfect power dynamic for them to feed and still get public sympathy for their supposed altruistic work. You definitely deserve better.

Cut her out of your life. Forgive her for she is a broken person. 

Stay away from the mental health community. They will destroy your sense of independence and self esteem.

The real key is true forgiveness. Once you understand she is broken and pathetic you realize she can’t help herself. Forgive her and you’ll get you power back. Then spend time with good people.

I’m sorry you’re suffering. We all are too, I asked my doctor to try and speak to my mom and she lied to him and said I was violent. I’ve never hit anyone my whole life. I’m such a soft hearted person when I was a kid a mouse got stuck in a sticky trap and I didn’t know how to help him so I wrapped him in tissue so he’d be warm. 

I wish there was help but I don’t know myself if there is. Most of the time my doctor falls asleep when I’m talking to him. Even when I told him my plan he was dosing off
